The attached Fool image is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its raw, smeared and scumbled oil paint, expressive distorted human contours, severe open geometric enclosures, isolated symbolic figures, burnt orange, oxblood, smoky mauve, pale cream and charcoal color fields. Create an ORIGINAL different composition for the specified tarot card, not a copy of a known painting or the reference scene. Strong central subject, readable tarot symbols, tension between flat empty space and vigorously worked paint. Fully clothed figures. Express distortion through paint and layered motion, not physical injury. All symbolic objects must remain distinct and countable, especially the specified number of cups, swords, wands or pentacle disks. No blood, wounds, gore, suffering animals, nudity, lettering, numerals, signature, decorative border, mockup or watermark. One flat portrait 3:5 illustration, highest available resolution. Important imagery inside central 85%, quiet outer margins for later typesetting.
Card: KING OF PENTACLES.
Scene: A mature king sits on a sturdy throne with subtle bull motifs and vine foliage, holding ONE golden pentacle disk and a simple scepter. A settled landscape behind. Responsible prosperity and stewardship.

cards.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one CARD BACK for this Francis Bacon-inspired tarot deck. The attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: use its raw smeared oil paint, burnt orange, oxblood, smoky mauve, chalk-white and charcoal, flat fields against agitated brushwork. An abstract two-way arrangement of TWO opposed pale gestural silhouettes inside a fine open geometric cage and TWO opposing circular floor shapes, around one dark central diamond. Precisely 180-degree rotational symmetry, equal weight at both ends, no upright-only horizon. Distorted shapes are paint marks, not injured bodies; no blood, gore or distress. No text, numerals, signature, watermark or mockup. One flat portrait 3:5 illustration, high resolution, entire back design visible.
